title: Member Services Desk Manual, E.1 — Holding Limit and Site Uniqueness on Refined Fuels and Propane Accounts
content:
A member may hold up to 4 accounts under Refined Fuels and Propane Accounts at once, counting every account that is not closed, because a farm ordinarily runs a propane tank at the house, another at the dryer, a farm diesel tank and a fleet fuelling arrangement, and each of those is its own tank on its own route.

**Uniqueness.** One account covers one fuel at one tank site. A second account is never opened for the same fuel at the same site, because the gauge readings and the keep-full schedule would then contradict one another. The two things that make an account unique are therefore the fuel and the tank site, taken together.

**Credit review.** A programme whose entry gate calls for a credit review is not opened until the credit department has recorded its decision on that member.

**Tank and leak check.** A programme whose entry gate calls for a tank is not brought into service until the tank is set and the system has passed its leak check where the programme requires one, and that check is recorded by the service technician rather than taken from the member's assurance that the plumber has already been. What settles this is the record of the energy request: its type, its standing and its reference, carried against the account number the request is being opened for. The desk reads the request standing before the account is brought into service, and the member's account of what the plumber did carries no weight against it.

**Yearly minimum.** The gallons a programme calls for as a yearly minimum are measured on the member's use over the previous twelve months, and a member below the minimum is written on the next programme down rather than refused fuel.

## Worked illustrations (hypothetical)

*Holding count.* A member holds three accounts standing open and one closed. The closed account is not counted, so the member stands at three of the four permitted and a fourth may be opened.

*Same fuel, same site.* A member with a propane account at the house tank asks for a second propane account at that same house tank. The fuel and the tank site are both the same, so no second account is opened. Had the request been for propane at the dryer, the tank site would differ and the account would be a distinct one.

*Below the minimum.* A member whose use over the previous twelve months falls short of the yearly gallons a programme is carried above is written on the next programme down. Fuel is not refused.
